title: Mobile mic needs an HTTPS choice: mkcert, or just the Chrome flag for now?

chat.text: The phone's microphone will never work over plain http://LAN-IP:port — that's the browser's own rule. mobile-voice-access task recommends mkcert (one-time local certificate authority, trusted once on the phone, works forever) over the zero-setup Chrome flag (fastest, but only that phone's Chrome and needs re-typing if the port changes). Either way a small Server/ change (serve https when HTTPS_CERT/KEY are set) still needs to be written — that's next, once you pick. Detail: public/framework/ai/2026-10-08/mobile-voice-access/findings.md and the new /framework/dev/mobile/ page.
